lead: A solar eclipse happens when the Moon passes in front of the Sun. This page shows when, and how much of the Sun is covered, from your city.
try: Choose an Eclipse and Where you watch, then watch the Moon cross the Sun.
points: Only along a narrow path does the Moon cover the whole Sun: that is a total eclipse. Everywhere else it takes only a bite.
Eclipses come in families that repeat every 18 years and 11 days.
Never look at the Sun without proper eclipse glasses, except during the few minutes when it is fully covered.
